metadata.title: Vintage Folk-Rock Album Cover Layout
useCases: Album art for acoustic or folk-rock bands

retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist 1970s layout featuring a central rounded-corner photograph framed by generous white space and stylized Art Nouveau-inspired custom lettering.
triggerTerms: Art Nouveau display lettering with centered photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, white square composition containing a central rectangular photograph with rounded corners, topped by large, olive-green custom lettering and enclosed by a delicate double-line border with ornamental corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale display lettering balanced against a central photographic window
Generous white negative space acting as a primary structural element
Earth-toned photograph contrasting with the stark white background
Delicate linear framing echoing the curves of the central image and typography
coreInvariants: Rounded corners on the central image frame
Double-line hairline border with concave corner details
Olive or moss green color for primary typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central horizontal photograph occupies the middle third of the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized custom lettering at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold top lettering down to the central photograph, then to the small logos at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounds all elements, creating a 'gallery' feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (brown, tan, muted red) within the photograph
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a warm, vintage photographic tint.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and white

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with flared terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters with exaggerated, curved legs that underline adjacent letters
Lowercase letters with tall, needle-like ascenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom display face paired with small, geometric sans-serif logos at the base.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Art Nouveau curves and weight
Matches the high-waisted, thin-line decorative style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square white canvas with a thin double-line black border featuring concave corners. In the center, place a horizontal rectangular photo of a band in a 1970s interior with rounded corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered custom Art Nouveau lettering in olive green above the photo, and small black-and-white logos centered at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the border a double hairline?
Is the typography in an Art Nouveau style?
Is there significant white space between all elements?

avoid: Digital-looking sharp corners on the image frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lettering does not touch the photo or the border.
Check that the border corners are concave, not square.
Verify the photo has a warm, vintage film grain or tint.
Confirm the typography is centered perfectly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered vintage photo, frame it with rounded corners, surround it with massive white space, and top it with Art Nouveau display type.
